Explanation: A scroll pane for a form page. The form puts the controls inside it in the Tab order.
Puts a control that has no Add action of its own on a form page.
Sets the height of the view in pixels.
Adds an item to the end of the scroll region.
Adds an item at the given index. Items after it move down one place.
Removes the item at the given index and returns it.
Returns the items in the scroll region in order.
Works out the page's Tab order again after its controls change.
Moves the keyboard focus to this control.
Moves the view up or down. 0 is the top.
